model: White Ambiance A60 B22 800 lm (2-pack, EAN 8719514328303)
name: Hue White Ambiance B22 (UK)

radios.note: Hue's UK page lists Bluetooth and Zigbee. The Hue Bridge FAQ says the bridge runs a private Zigbee network for Hue lights.

matter.note: Hue's UK page lists Matter among third-party systems, but we found no CSA listing for this EAN. Hue's guide offers Matter through the Hue Bridge. Not confirmed for the bulb itself.

apple_home.note: Hue's page lists Apple HomeKit and says voice-assistant control needs the bridge. Hue's Matter guide says the bridge also connects bulbs without Matter to Apple Home.

google_home.note: Hue's page lists Google Home. Hue's (US) FAQ says Bluetooth Hue lights pair without a Bridge with Nest Mini, Nest Hub and Nest Hub Max (up to 10 lights); the UK page lists voice control under 'Hue Bridge required'. With a Bridge it uses Hue's own integration.

alexa.note: Hue's page lists Alexa. Hue's (US) FAQ says Bluetooth Hue lights pair without a Bridge with an Echo (4th gen), Echo Show or newer; the UK page lists voice control under 'Hue Bridge required'. With a Bridge it uses Hue's own skill.

smartthings.note: Hue's page lists Samsung SmartThings; Hue's FAQ puts SmartThings on the Bridge side, not Bluetooth.

home_assistant.note: Official Hue integration, which pairs with the Hue Bridge. The docs don't name this specific bulb.

hubRequired.note: Here this means needing a bridge for basic app control. The Hue app controls it over Bluetooth (about 9 m); Apple Home, SmartThings and the full feature set need a Hue Bridge.

localControl.note: Bluetooth control from a phone works without internet; Home Assistant talks to the Hue Bridge over its local API.

colorType.note: Adjustable white from 2200 to 6500 K; no colour.

lumens.note: Sold as '800 lumen'; the page states up to 806 lm at 4000 K.

summary: Hue White Ambiance A60 B22 in the UK 2-pack runs from 2200 to 6500 K at up to 806 lumens, on a bayonet cap. The Hue app controls it over Bluetooth without a bridge, and Hue's FAQ says Bluetooth lights pair directly with recent Echo and Google Nest speakers. Apple Home and SmartThings need a Hue Bridge, and Home Assistant uses the Hue integration.
caveats: Apple Home and SmartThings need a Hue Bridge. The UK page lists voice control under 'Hue Bridge required', though Hue's FAQ describes Bluetooth pairing with recent Echo and Nest speakers.
Matter works through the Hue Bridge; we found no Matter listing for the bulb itself.
